question_text: You need assistance on the autobahn. Which information does the arrow on the roadside marker give you?

options.text: Nearest emergency call telephone in the direction of the arrow
Nearest car park in the direction of the arrow
Next exit in the direction of the arrow

correct_answers.text: Nearest emergency call telephone in the direction of the arrow

comment: Arrows on the reflector posts on the edge of a freeway point towards the nearest emergency services pillar. If you need help, follow the arrows to reach an emergency pillar as quickly as possible.
